title: A股港股早报：铀铜领涨、黄金走强，夜盘ETF微升但科技分化 + 美股盘前：长债与光通信施压，PDD和钢铁获正反馈
summary: Moomoo完整读取145个美股行业，铀、铜和焦煤领涨，黄金上涨3.31%、贵金属上涨2.62%，白银与半导体偏弱；QQQ、SPY、DIA夜盘代理小涨，行业代表股为2项确认、2项潜在反转、6项无成交。长飞与贝壳业绩超预期，紫金竞价受金铜行情支撑但业绩低于一致预期。 纳指期指约跌0.7%、标普500期指跌0.2%，10年期美债约4.72%，成长估值继续受压；PDD虽营收低于预期但利润超预期后盘前涨约3.2%，STLD与NUE放量上涨，而AAOI、COHR、SNDK、LITE和MU明显走弱。

entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
国际
伊朗警告支持美国新经济措施将被视为战争行为
美联社8月23日报道，伊朗最高安全机构新负责人警告，任何国家支持美国即将公布的新经济措施都将被视为“战争行为”；美国财政部长预计周一公布进一步制裁。事实层面提高能源、黄金和航运风险溢价，也抬升亚洲输入型通胀的不确定性。
国际
波斯湾替代航线亦面临报复威胁，油运风险尚未解除
伊朗方面称，若邻国加入美国所谓“经济战”，可能针对波斯湾其他油运通道；同时伊朗总统仍把与美国的谅解备忘录称为打破僵局的最佳路径。外交与报复信号并存，A/H开盘应把油价上冲视为能源利多与成长估值利空的双向变量。
科技
Moomoo行业全榜显示铀铜领涨，黄金与白银明显分化
本次完整读取Moomoo美股行业榜5页、145个行业：铀+7.96%、铜+7.86%、焦煤+4.90%、汽车制造+4.35%、资本市场+3.73%居前；末端依次为建筑-1.32%、烟草-1.41%、燃气公用-1.49%、电力公用-2.16%、公用事业多元化-3.29%。黄金+3.31%、贵金属+2.62%，但白银-1.13%；A/H资源映射以金铜铀优先，避免把贵金属整体视为同涨。
科技
Sparks正向主题偏向加密、稀土与锂，完整概念榜未完成
Futunn Sparks当前可见卡片显示SOL储备+9.27%、稀土+7.60%、以太坊储备+7.45%、加密货币+6.15%、锂矿+5.86%；但反爬与加载限制使完整负榜、代表股和涨跌家数未能可靠取得，因此首页概念分组明确标注未完成。可见信号仅用于主题补充，不作为完整概念广度结论。
科技
隔夜科技内部继续分化，Marvell与光通信回撤
Futu现金时段数据显示MRVL -5.57%、LITE -1.43%、MU -0.77%、NVDA -0.98%，AMD +0.81%、TSLA +5.14%；Moomoo半导体行业-0.32%，半导体设备材料仅+0.05%。A/H映射上，CPO、存储和国产算力不宜按主题普涨交易，需观察中际旭创、长飞光纤与同业是否同步放量。
科技
中兴上半年收入创纪录，算力收入占比超过三成
中兴通讯公告上半年收入780亿元创历史新高，算力收入占比超过35%；Futu二季度口径收入430.37亿元，高于预期397.92亿元，但EPS 0.29略低于0.295、EBIT 15.95亿元低于预期17.92亿元。增长结构利好国产算力与光传输，利润兑现仍需港股和A股成交确认。
财报
长飞光纤二季度盈利、收入与EBIT均超预期
Futu财报日历显示长飞光纤二季度EPS 2.95，高于预期1.935；收入61.14亿元，高于预期60.47亿元；EBIT 27.61亿元，高于预期15.94亿元。09:19 CST竞价参考约144.8港元、较140港元昨收高3.43%，但尚无有效成交，光通信链需开盘后确认扩散。
财报
贝壳二季度核心指标超预期，竞价参考温和偏强
贝壳二季度EPS 0.78，高于预期0.6292；收入245.39亿元，高于预期242.47亿元；EBIT 35.92亿元，高于预期27.86亿元。09:19 CST竞价参考46港元、较45.38港元昨收高1.37%，房地产服务链可观察但不等同于地产板块全面反转。
财报
紫金矿业业绩低于一致预期，金铜行情支撑竞价
紫金矿业二季度收入956.81亿元，低于预期1089.30亿元；EBIT 320.84亿元，低于预期331.31亿元。09:19 CST竞价参考41港元、较38.56港元昨收高6.33%，说明金铜价格强势暂时覆盖业绩缺口；若正式开盘后缺口快速回补，应转为风险观察而非追涨。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
夜盘ETF代理小幅上行，风险偏好仅温和改善
Futu OpenD订阅行情于2026-08-24 09:19 CST显示：QQQ（纳指100代理）+0.183%、SPY（标普500代理）+0.141%、DIA（道指代理）+0.024%。这些是ETF夜盘代理而非指数期货；字段对应周日晚间交易，源未标示延迟，实际现金收盘日期为8月21日。
板块对照
板块对照：两项确认、两项潜在反转，六只代表股无夜盘成交
逐项复核行业panel：铀/ISOU不可得，铜/IE +0.088%确认，焦煤/AMR不可得，汽车制造/CENN +2.750%确认，资本市场/USDE -1.889%潜在反转；建筑/FBGL +1.209%潜在反转，烟草/RYM不可得，燃气公用/SPH不可得，电力公用/NKLR不可得，公用事业多元化/BIP不可得。概念榜未完成，无法形成可靠夜盘逐项对照；合计2项确认、2项潜在反转、6项不可得，未观察到可量化背离。
A/H映射
A/H映射：资源仍占优，但资本市场与建筑反向信号限制追高
QQQ、SPY、DIA微升为A/H科技提供轻微增量支撑，铜代表股IE延续强势；但资本市场领涨股USDE夜盘转跌、建筑领涨股FBGL在行业下跌后反升，说明隔夜排序已出现局部反转。若紫金和长飞正式开盘守住昨收且科技同业放量，可保留选择性进攻；若高开缺口回补或油价推升长端利率，夜盘增量信号失效。

盘前结论

Moomoo行业全榜的铀、铜、焦煤以及黄金/贵金属形成明确资源优势，铜代表股IE夜盘继续上涨，A/H优先观察紫金矿业、洛阳钼业和铀资源链。但白银-1.13%、半导体-0.32%，资本市场领涨股USDE夜盘-1.889%形成潜在反转，不能把资源和风险资产的强势简单外推为全面风险偏好回归。

科技采用“业绩与成交双确认”：长飞财报全面超预期，中兴收入强但利润指标混合；QQQ仅+0.183%，MRVL与LITE现金时段回撤。开盘后只有CPO、算力和存储同业同步放量，才保留进攻仓位。

概念榜因Sparks完整负榜与规定字段未取得而明确降级，当前可见的稀土、锂和加密主题只作线索。若紫金41港元和长飞144.8港元附近的竞价缺口快速回补，短线应降低追高并转向盈利兑现更清晰的标的。

重点个股推荐

紫金矿业
02899.HK
金铜双映射

推荐理由：黄金行业+3.31%、铜行业+7.86%，公司同时承接金铜景气，竞价参考较昨收高6.33%。

触发因素：正式开盘后守住38.56港元昨收，且成交放大并强于恒指和黄金同业。

风险点：收入和EBIT均低于一致预期；若41港元附近高开缺口快速回补，不宜追涨。

长飞光纤光缆
06869.HK
财报与CPO

推荐理由：二季度EPS、收入和EBIT全面超预期，直接承接光纤、数据中心互联和CPO需求。

触发因素：开盘后守住140港元昨收，且中际旭创、光迅科技等同业同步放量。

风险点：竞价参考144.8港元尚无有效成交；LITE现金时段和夜盘均偏弱。

中兴通讯
00763.HK
国产算力

推荐理由：上半年收入780亿元创纪录，算力收入占比超过35%，二季度收入亦高于预期。

触发因素：港股守住23.86港元昨收，A/H两地成交同步扩张，算力与通信设备指数转强。

风险点：二季度EPS和EBIT略低于预期，利润率不及收入增速可能限制估值修复。

洛阳钼业
03993.HK
铜钴映射

推荐理由：Moomoo铜行业涨7.86%位居第二，IE夜盘再涨0.088%形成同向确认。

触发因素：铜价与港股有色板块继续走强，公司开盘后放量并强于紫金以外的资源同业。

风险点：资源股高开拥挤、美元反弹或中东风险缓和都可能触发商品获利回吐。

贝壳-W
02423.HK
盈利超预期

推荐理由：EPS、收入和EBIT均高于预期，经营兑现优于地产行业的宏观不确定性。

触发因素：开盘后守住45.38港元昨收，并获得平台互联网及地产服务同业成交支持。

风险点：行业需求与政策预期仍不稳定，单季超预期不等同于地产板块趋势反转。

板块轮动看板

受益方向铀、铜、黄金、焦煤与选择性光通信；资源强度由完整行业榜确认。
观察方向国产算力、CPO、稀土、锂矿与平台互联网；必须等待开盘后量价和同业扩散。
压力方向电力公用、燃气公用、烟草、建筑与广义半导体；资本市场领涨股夜盘亦出现反转。
验证信号紫金和长飞能否守住昨收、IE强势能否延续、QQQ是否保持正值、科技同业是否同步放量。

逻辑链

伊朗制裁与油运威胁维持能源和避险溢价，美股黄金、铀和铜行业显著走强。
Moomoo完整行业榜显示资源居前、半导体偏弱，A/H映射先看金铜铀而非科技普涨。
QQQ、SPY、DIA夜盘代理微升，但USDE与FBGL出现反向信号，风险偏好改善不均衡。
长飞、贝壳业绩超预期，中兴收入强而利润混合，个股交易转向业绩与成交双确认。
若资源股守住昨收且科技同业放量，可选择性进攻；若竞价缺口回补或利率上行，则降低高估值仓位。

风险雷达

中东与油运风险再升级

新制裁或报复可能推高油价、通胀和亚洲进口成本。

资源高开后的获利回吐

铀、铜和黄金涨幅集中，若美元或利率反弹，追高回撤风险上升。

科技板块缺乏广度

半导体行业下跌，MRVL、LITE、MU与NVDA现金时段均偏弱。

Sparks概念榜未完成

完整负榜、代表股和涨跌家数未可靠取得，主题线索不得当作完整广度。

港股竞价参考失真

09:19前多只财报股尚无有效成交，高开指示不等于正式趋势。

数据来源与时间点

来源：Moomoo美股行业榜（2026-08-24 09:11 CST检查，页面显示08/23 21:11 ET；完整读取5页、145行业，黄金、贵金属、白银、铜与半导体已重点核验）；Futunn Sparks（09:12 CST单次页面检查，仅可见正向主题卡片，完整负榜及规定字段受反爬/加载限制，概念榜未完成）；Futu OpenD HK/SH/SZ财报日历、NOTICE搜索、财报价格与港股竞价快照（09:17—09:19 CST）；Futu OpenD订阅的QQQ/SPY/DIA及10只行业代表股夜盘字段（09:19 CST，ETF代理非指数期货，源未标示延迟，现金数据日期08/21）；AP关于08/23伊朗制裁与油运威胁；中兴通讯08/21业绩公告。抓取时间为Asia/Shanghai。
entries.html_en:
Major News Roundup
Global
Iran says support for new US economic measures would be an act of war
AP reported on August 23 that the new head of Iran's top security body warned that any country supporting forthcoming US economic measures would be treated as committing an “act of war”; the US Treasury secretary is expected to announce additional sanctions Monday. The facts raise energy, gold and shipping risk premia while increasing uncertainty around imported inflation in Asia.
Global
Retaliation threats extend to alternative Gulf oil routes
Iran said it could target other Gulf oil-shipping routes if neighboring countries join what it calls the US “economic war,” while Iran's president still described a memorandum with the United States as the best route out of the stalemate. With diplomacy and retaliation signals coexisting, an oil spike is both an energy-sector positive and a valuation negative for growth stocks.
Tech
Full Moomoo industry scan puts uranium and copper first as gold and silver diverge
All five Moomoo pages and 145 US industries were read: Uranium +7.96%, Copper +7.86%, Coking Coal +4.90%, Auto Manufacturers +4.35% and Capital Markets +3.73% led. The bottom sequence was Construction -1.32%, Tobacco -1.41%, Regulated Gas Utilities -1.49%, Regulated Electric Utilities -2.16% and Diversified Utilities -3.29%. Gold rose 3.31% and Precious Metals 2.62%, but Silver fell 1.13%; A/H mapping therefore favors gold, copper and uranium rather than a blanket precious-metals trade.
Tech
Visible Sparks themes favor crypto, rare earths and lithium; full concept ranking incomplete
Visible Futunn Sparks cards showed SOL Reserve +9.27%, Rare Earths +7.60%, ETH Holding Companies +7.45%, Crypto +6.15% and Lithium Miners +5.86%. Anti-bot and loading limits prevented reliable retrieval of the complete negative list, representative stocks and breadth counts, so the homepage concept group is explicitly marked incomplete. These visible signals are theme supplements, not a complete concept-breadth conclusion.
Tech
Overnight technology remained split as Marvell and optical names retreated
Futu cash-session data showed MRVL -5.57%, LITE -1.43%, MU -0.77% and NVDA -0.98%, versus AMD +0.81% and TSLA +5.14%; Moomoo Semiconductors fell 0.32% while Semiconductor Equipment & Materials added only 0.05%. For A/H, CPO, memory and domestic compute should not be traded as a broad theme unless Zhongji Innolight, YOFC and peers expand together on volume.
Tech
ZTE posts record first-half revenue as computing exceeds one-third of sales
ZTE reported record first-half revenue of RMB78.0 billion, with computing contributing more than 35%. Futu's second-quarter view showed revenue of RMB43.04 billion versus RMB39.79 billion expected, but EPS of 0.29 versus 0.295 and EBIT of RMB1.595 billion versus RMB1.792 billion expected. The mix supports domestic compute and optical transport, while profit delivery still needs volume confirmation in both listings.
Earnings
YOFC beats expectations on EPS, revenue and EBIT
Futu's earnings calendar showed YOFC second-quarter EPS of 2.95 versus 1.935 expected, revenue of RMB6.114 billion versus RMB6.047 billion, and EBIT of RMB2.761 billion versus RMB1.594 billion. Its 09:19 CST auction indication was about HK$144.8, 3.43% above the HK$140 prior close, but with no effective trade yet; optical-chain breadth must confirm after the open.
Earnings
KE Holdings beats on core metrics with a mildly positive auction indication
KE Holdings posted second-quarter EPS of 0.78 versus 0.6292 expected, revenue of RMB24.539 billion versus RMB24.247 billion, and EBIT of RMB3.592 billion versus RMB2.786 billion. Its 09:19 CST auction indication was HK$46, 1.37% above the HK$45.38 prior close; the property-services name is worth watching, but this does not establish a broad property reversal.
Earnings
Zijin misses consensus as gold and copper support its auction indication
Zijin Mining's second-quarter revenue was RMB95.681 billion versus RMB108.930 billion expected, while EBIT was RMB32.084 billion versus RMB33.131 billion. Its 09:19 CST auction indication was HK$41, 6.33% above the HK$38.56 prior close, suggesting strong gold and copper prices temporarily outweighed the miss; a fast gap fill after the open would shift it from a long candidate to a risk watch.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight Indexes
Overnight ETF proxies edge higher, signaling only a mild risk improvement
Futu OpenD subscribed quotes at 2026-08-24 09:19 CST showed QQQ (Nasdaq-100 proxy) +0.183%, SPY (S&P 500 proxy) +0.141% and DIA (Dow proxy) +0.024%. These are overnight ETF proxies, not index futures; the fields reflect Sunday-evening trading, the source does not flag delay status, and the underlying cash close date was August 21.
Sector Check
Sector check: two confirmations, two potential reversals and six no-trade readings
Industry-panel representatives were checked line by line: Uranium/ISOU unavailable, Copper/IE +0.088% confirmation, Coking Coal/AMR unavailable, Auto Manufacturers/CENN +2.750% confirmation, Capital Markets/USDE -1.889% potential reversal; Construction/FBGL +1.209% potential reversal, Tobacco/RYM unavailable, Regulated Gas Utilities/SPH unavailable, Regulated Electric Utilities/NKLR unavailable, Diversified Utilities/BIP unavailable. The incomplete concept ranking could not support a reliable line-by-line overnight comparison. Total: two confirmations, two potential reversals, six unavailable and no quantifiable divergence.
A/H Mapping
A/H mapping: resources retain the edge, but reversals in capital markets and construction cap chasing
Small gains in QQQ, SPY and DIA provide a mild incremental tailwind for A/H technology, while copper representative IE extended its rise. Yet capital-markets leader USDE turned lower overnight and construction leader FBGL rose after its industry fell, showing local reversals in the prior ranking. Selective offense remains valid only if Zijin and YOFC hold their prior closes and tech peers expand on volume; a gap fill or an oil-driven yield rise invalidates the overnight signal.

Pre-Market Conclusion

The full Moomoo scan shows a clear resource advantage in uranium, copper, coking coal, gold and precious metals, while copper representative IE extended higher overnight; A/H attention should start with Zijin, CMOC and uranium exposure.Silver fell 1.13%, Semiconductors lost 0.32%, and capital-markets leader USDE reversed 1.889% lower overnight, so resource and risk-asset strength cannot be extrapolated into a broad risk-on call.

Technology needs both earnings and volume confirmation: YOFC beat across metrics, while ZTE delivered strong revenue but mixed profit measures; QQQ rose only 0.183%, and MRVL and LITE retreated in cash trading. CPO, compute and memory remain actionable only if peers expand together after the open.

The concept ranking is explicitly degraded because the complete Sparks negative list and required fields were unavailable; visible rare-earth, lithium and crypto themes are clues only. If the auction gaps around HK$41 for Zijin or HK$144.8 for YOFC fill quickly, reduce chasing and favor clearer earnings delivery.

Risk: Crowded resource gaps, a dollar rebound or easing Middle East risk could trigger commodity profit-taking.

Logic Chain

Iran sanctions and shipping threats maintain energy and haven premia, lifting US gold, uranium and copper industries.
The full Moomoo scan puts resources first and semiconductors lower, so A/H mapping starts with gold, copper and uranium rather than broad tech.
QQQ, SPY and DIA overnight proxies edged up, but USDE and FBGL moved opposite their prior industry directions, showing uneven risk improvement.
YOFC and KE Holdings beat expectations while ZTE paired strong revenue with mixed profit measures, shifting stock selection to earnings plus volume confirmation.
If resources hold prior closes and tech peers expand, keep selective offense; if auction gaps fill or yields rise, reduce high-valuation exposure.

New sanctions or retaliation could raise oil prices, inflation and Asian import costs.

Uranium, copper and gold gains are concentrated; a dollar or yield rebound would increase chasing risk.

Technology lacks breadth

Semiconductors fell, while MRVL, LITE, MU and NVDA all weakened in the cash session.

Sparks concept ranking incomplete

利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
期指
纳指期指约跌0.7%，科技领跌盘前
美联社盘前显示纳指期指约跌0.7%、标普500期指跌0.2%、道指期指跌0.1%。周五三大指数反弹后，周一资金重新降低高久期科技敞口。
利率
10年期美债约4.72%，30年期仍近2007年以来高位
财政部扩大长债回购只带来短暂缓解，10年期收益率从周五4.73%附近小幅回落至约4.72%。高融资成本继续压制成长估值和消费信贷。
宏观
PCE、GDP修正与Jackson Hole构成本周风险墙
周三将公布7月PCE和二季度GDP二次估算，首次GDP年化增速仅1.5%；周后段市场将听取美联储主席Warsh在Jackson Hole的政策信号。
能源
油价回落，但伊朗制裁与航运尾险未消失
布油约跌1.7%至91.06美元，WTI约跌2.2%至85.18美元；美国准备追加对伊朗制裁，波斯湾航运恢复时间仍不确定，油价—通胀—利率链条仍是尾部风险。
汇率
美元兑日元升至159.23，欧元回落至1.1665美元
美元在长端收益率高位支撑下保持韧性。强美元叠加高利率对跨国科技盈利折算和新兴市场风险偏好均不友好。
财报
PDD利润超预期、营收不及预期，股价仍获买盘
PDD二季度EPS约19.33元，高于18.35元预期；营收1123.6亿元，低于1139亿元预期。盘前约涨3.2%至91.18美元、成交约683万股，显示市场更重视利润和运营杠杆。
材料科技
钢铁链逆势放量，STLD与NUE居大盘前列
STLD盘前约涨4.8%、成交约198万股；NUE约涨4.5%、成交约188万股。两者显著强于指数，材料与本土制造成为科技去风险时的轮动承接方向。
科技
光通信与存储链遭集中去风险
盘前AAOI约跌12.4%、COHR跌5.7%、SNDK跌5.4%、LITE跌5.3%、MU跌3.1%；其中AAOI的6亿美元股票发行计划放大稀释担忧，板块价格反馈整体偏空。
AI
NVDA周三财报前盘前走弱，AI链进入验证窗口
NVDA盘前约跌1%，MRVL跌近3%，市场等待周三NVDA对AI资本开支与需求广度的确认。高预期意味着即使数字超预期，指引与毛利率仍决定价格反应。
财报日历
今晚无大型科技财报，只有小型科技样本
Kiplinger/Briefing.com称今晚没有值得关注的盘后报告；EarningSpike则列出TUYA、GRRR和AIIO等小型科技公司。日历口径冲突且卖方覆盖有限，概率判断只能低置信度使用。

盘前结论

PDD在营收不及预期后仍被买入，STLD与NUE则以约4%—5%的涨幅和百万级盘前成交确认相对强势。资金更偏好已获得价格验证的盈利或材料线索，而非无差别抄底AI链。

纳指期指领跌、10年期美债维持约4.72%，加上光通信和存储链集体下挫，开盘基准情景是科技承压、指数低开后分化。油价当日回落提供有限的通胀缓冲，若收益率同步走低，指数仍有修复空间。

若10Y回落到4.70%下方且光通信跌幅收窄，纳指可能出现日内修复；若10Y重返4.73%上方、COHR/SNDK继续放量下探，则优先防守并回避科技弱势反弹。

重点个股推荐

PDD Holdings
PDD
财报正反馈

推荐理由：EPS高于预期、营收略低于预期后，盘前仍约涨3.2%，成交约683万股，利润改善获得真实买盘确认。

触发因素：开盘守住89美元附近并继续强于KWEB及电商同业，成交扩张。

风险点：营收缺口、跨境电商监管与投入回升可能使利润驱动的反弹失速。

Steel Dynamics
STLD
放量材料

推荐理由：盘前约涨4.8%、成交约198万股，在三大期指偏弱时仍显著跑赢，显示本土钢铁与制造轮动有价格确认。

触发因素：开盘守住盘前区间且继续强于XLB、NUE，成交保持活跃。

风险点：关税或政策预期回吐、钢价走弱和高开获利盘可能造成缺口回补。

Nucor
NUE
钢铁共振

推荐理由：盘前约涨4.5%、成交约188万股，与STLD形成板块共振，并对科技去风险提供低久期替代。

触发因素：守住250美元附近、STLD同步强势且材料板块开盘广度扩张。

风险点：若两只龙头同时跌破盘前支撑，轮动可能只是短线拥挤交易。

United Microelectronics
UMC
半导体相对强势

推荐理由：盘前约涨5.8%、成交约512万股，在MU、SNDK和光通信链下跌时呈现稀缺的半导体相对强度。

触发因素：开盘维持5%以上涨幅并强于SOXX，成交继续放大。

风险点：若半导体系统性抛压扩大，孤立强势可能迅速收敛；需避免在涨幅失守时追高。

板块轮动看板

强势观察钢铁与材料、财报后获买盘的PDD、相对强势的UMC；只跟随价格和成交确认。
事件驱动PDD财报、AAOI股票发行、周三PCE与NVDA财报，以及Jackson Hole政策信号。
压力方向AAOI、COHR、SNDK、LITE、MU、MRVL及其他高估值光通信、存储和AI基础设施股票。
验证信号10Y能否跌破4.70%、光通信跌幅是否收窄、PDD能否守住财报反弹、STLD/NUE能否维持放量共振。

逻辑链

长端收益率高企并叠加PCE、NVDA与Jackson Hole事件风险，资金先削减高久期科技敞口。
AAOI融资稀释触发光通信链扩散性抛压，COHR、SNDK、LITE和MU的负反馈确认科技内部风险偏好下降。
PDD利润超预期后逆势上涨，STLD与NUE放量共振，资金转向有盈利或低久期材料支撑的标的。
若收益率回落且弱势科技止跌，指数可修复；否则维持板块分化并优先跟随PDD与钢铁的相对强度。

盘后财报 beat 概率

以下为基于已知预期、历史 surprise、近期指引、卖方修正和行业景气的主观判断，不是确定事实。已检查EarningSpike、Kiplinger/Briefing.com、Investing.com及Schwab科技财报日历；今晚没有可验证的大型科技公司，且小型样本的覆盖明显不足。

中概率 · Tuya (TUYA) · 55%物联网平台业务具备软件毛利弹性，但公开一致预期、近期卖方修正和历史surprise细节有限；仅因日历确认盘后披露而给略高于五成、低置信度判断。
低至中概率 · Gorilla Technology (GRRR) · 45%AI与智慧城市订单提供行业景气想象，但小盘项目型收入波动大、卖方覆盖稀疏，近期指引可验证性不足，故低于五成。
低概率 · Robo.ai (AIIO) · 35%自动驾驶与AI概念弹性高，但缺少稳定的一致预期、连续历史surprise和可靠修正样本；高波动不能替代基本面证据。

风险雷达

长端收益率再创新高

10Y约4.72%、30Y接近2007年以来高位；PCE偏热会继续压缩成长估值。

光通信抛压扩散

AAOI融资稀释已伴随COHR、SNDK和LITE大跌；这些标的只作回避追多和等待止跌观察。

伊朗与波斯湾航运尾险

油价当日回落不代表冲突解除，新制裁或运输中断可能重新推高通胀和收益率。

强势股高开回补

PDD、STLD、NUE和UMC已有盘前涨幅，若开盘成交衰减，不能把早盘动量等同于全天趋势。

数据来源与时间点

来源：AP（期指、美债、油价、汇率、伊朗与宏观日历）；Stocknear（2026-08-24盘前涨跌、成交量和相对强弱）；Investing.com（PDD财报预期与结果）；AAOI公司融资信息的公开市场汇总；EarningSpike、Kiplinger/Briefing.com、Schwab与Investing.com财报日历。抓取时间：2026-08-24 20:34 CST。个股仅在盘前价格、成交与板块相对强度同向时列为候选。

Major News Roundup
Futures
Nasdaq futures fall about 0.7% as technology leads premarket losses
AP showed Nasdaq futures down about 0.7%, S&P 500 futures off 0.2% and Dow futures down 0.1%. After Friday's rebound, investors are again reducing long-duration technology exposure.
Rates
The 10-year Treasury holds near 4.72% as the 30-year stays near a 2007 high
Expanded Treasury buybacks delivered only temporary relief, with the 10-year easing slightly from about 4.73% Friday to 4.72%. High financing costs continue to weigh on growth valuations and consumer credit.
Macro
PCE, the GDP revision and Jackson Hole form this week's risk wall
July PCE and the second estimate of second-quarter GDP arrive Wednesday after the initial 1.5% annualized growth reading; markets will then parse Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole policy signal.
Energy
Oil retreats, but Iran sanctions and shipping tail risk remain
Brent fell about 1.7% to $91.06 and WTI 2.2% to $85.18. The US is preparing more Iran sanctions and the timing of normalized Gulf shipping remains uncertain, keeping the oil-inflation-rates chain alive.
FX
Dollar-yen rises to 159.23 as the euro slips to $1.1665
The dollar remains resilient with long yields elevated. A strong dollar plus high rates is unfavorable for multinational technology earnings translation and emerging-market risk appetite.
Earnings
PDD misses revenue but beats profit and still attracts buyers
PDD reported second-quarter EPS near RMB19.33 versus RMB18.35 expected, while revenue of RMB112.36 billion missed RMB113.9 billion. Shares rose about 3.2% to $91.18 on roughly 6.83 million premarket shares as investors favored profit and operating leverage.
Materials Tech
Steel rallies on volume as STLD and NUE lead large-cap gainers
STLD rose about 4.8% on roughly 1.98 million shares and NUE gained 4.5% on 1.88 million. Both sharply outperformed the indexes, making materials and domestic manufacturing a rotation destination during technology de-risking.
Tech
Optical and storage names face concentrated de-risking
AAOI fell about 12.4%, COHR 5.7%, SNDK 5.4%, LITE 5.3% and MU 3.1% premarket. AAOI's $600 million stock-sale plan amplified dilution concerns while the broader group showed bearish price feedback.
AI
NVDA weakens before Wednesday's earnings as AI enters a validation window
NVDA slipped about 1% and MRVL nearly 3% premarket as investors await Nvidia's read on AI capex and demand breadth. High expectations mean guidance and margins will matter even if headline numbers beat.
Calendar
No large-cap tech report tonight; only small technology samples
Kiplinger/Briefing.com says no noteworthy after-close report is scheduled, while EarningSpike lists TUYA, GRRR and AIIO. Conflicting calendars and thin sell-side coverage make any probability estimate low-confidence.

Pre-Market Conclusion

PDD is being bought despite a revenue miss, while STLD and NUE confirm relative strength with 4%-5% gains and million-share premarket volume.Capital favors earnings or materials themes with verified price feedback rather than a broad AI dip-buy.

Nasdaq futures are leading lower, the 10-year Treasury holds near 4.72%, and optical and storage names are falling together, making technology pressure and a split open the base case.Lower oil provides a limited inflation buffer and could help indexes repair if yields also ease.

If the 10-year falls below 4.70% and optical losses narrow, Nasdaq could repair intraday; if it retakes 4.73% and COHR/SNDK extend lower on volume, stay defensive and avoid weak-tech rebounds.

Priority Stock Ideas

PDD Holdings
PDD
Earnings Reaction

Rationale: EPS beat and revenue modestly missed, yet shares gained about 3.2% on roughly 6.83 million premarket shares, confirming real demand for improved profit.

Trigger: Hold near $89 after the open while outperforming KWEB and e-commerce peers on expanding volume.

Risk: The revenue miss, cross-border regulation and renewed investment could reverse a profit-driven rally.

Steel Dynamics
STLD
Volume Leader

Rationale: Shares rose about 4.8% on roughly 1.98 million premarket shares, sharply outperforming weak futures and confirming a domestic steel and manufacturing rotation.

Trigger: Hold the premarket range, stay ahead of XLB and NUE, and retain active volume.

Risk: A reversal in tariff or policy expectations, weaker steel pricing or profit-taking could fill the opening gap.

Nucor
NUE
Steel Confirmation

Rationale: Shares rose about 4.5% on roughly 1.88 million premarket shares, confirming STLD's move and offering a lower-duration alternative to technology.

Trigger: Hold near $250 as STLD remains firm and materials breadth expands after the open.

Risk: If both leaders lose premarket support, the rotation may prove a crowded short-term trade.

United Microelectronics
UMC
Relative Chip Strength

Rationale: Shares rose about 5.8% on roughly 5.12 million premarket shares, rare semiconductor strength while MU, SNDK and optical peers sold off.

Trigger: Retain a gain above 5%, outperform SOXX and extend volume after the open.

Risk: Systemic semiconductor selling could erase isolated strength; do not chase if the gain breaks down.

Sector Rotation Board

Strength WatchSteel and materials, post-earnings PDD and relatively strong UMC; follow only verified price and volume.
Event-DrivenPDD earnings, AAOI's stock sale, Wednesday's PCE and NVDA results, and Jackson Hole policy signals.
Pressure AreasAAOI, COHR, SNDK, LITE, MU, MRVL and other high-valuation optical, storage and AI infrastructure names.
Validation SignalsWhether the 10-year breaks 4.70%, optical losses narrow, PDD holds its earnings gain and STLD/NUE retain volume confirmation.

Logic Chain

Elevated long yields plus PCE, NVDA and Jackson Hole event risk lead investors to reduce long-duration technology exposure.
AAOI dilution triggers broader optical selling, with negative feedback in COHR, SNDK, LITE and MU confirming weaker tech risk appetite.
PDD rises on its profit beat while STLD and NUE rally together on volume, rotating capital toward earnings support and lower-duration materials.
If yields fall and weak tech stabilizes, indexes can repair; otherwise preserve the split and follow relative strength in PDD and steel.

After-Hours Earnings Beat Probability

These are subjective judgments based on known expectations, historical surprise patterns, recent guidance, sell-side revisions and industry conditions—not facts. EarningSpike, Kiplinger/Briefing.com, Investing.com and Schwab calendars were checked; no verifiable large-cap technology company reports tonight, and small-company coverage is thin.

Medium · Tuya (TUYA) · 55%The IoT platform offers software-margin leverage, but public consensus, recent revision and historical-surprise detail is limited; calendar confirmation supports only a low-confidence, slightly-above-even judgment.
Low-Medium · Gorilla Technology (GRRR) · 45%AI and smart-city orders provide an industry tailwind, but project revenue is volatile, sell-side coverage sparse and recent guidance hard to verify, keeping odds below half.
Low · Robo.ai (AIIO) · 35%Autonomous-driving and AI exposure creates volatility, but stable consensus, repeated historical surprises and reliable revision data are missing; price beta is not fundamental evidence.

Risk Radar

Long yields make new highs
